title: Lemons, a kraak bowl and a knife
note: Still life in the Dutch manner: three lemons, one cut with its peel hanging over the edge, a blue-and-white bowl and a pewter knife on a rumpled linen cloth. Oil on toned canvas. Written by paintings/lemons.gen.mjs.

imprimatura.note: a thin wash of umber over the whole canvas

thin.note: paint thinned with turpentine for the dead colouring

wall.note: the wall: thin, rubbed in, a little oily

dark.note: the darks: thin but oily, so they keep some gloss

impasto.note: thick lead white and its tints, laid on and left

clean.note: a clean touch that does not mix with what is wet beneath

shadow glaze.note: transparent umber for the cast shadows

skin.note: lemon skin: oily, pitted with pores

peel.note: the outside of the peel: waxy, not shiny

cobalt.note: the blue, laid into the wet white so that its edges soften like blue under a glaze

glint.note: the last thick white on a glossy thing

juice.note: wet juice: a bead of clear yellow

pewter.note: soft grey metal, not quite polished

pewter paint.note: grey paint with a little metal in it, for the reflections on the blade

hog.note: a big worn hog brush for the background

scrub.note: nearly dry, dragged so it catches the weave

fil soft.note: a softer filbert for blending passages

drybrush.note: almost dry, catches only the ridges

steps.name: Imprimatura
steps.note: A thin wash of umber over the whole canvas, darker toward the top and the right.

steps.name: Drawing
steps.note: The objects found with a brush and thin dark paint, loosely, more than once.

steps.name: Wall
steps.note: The dark ground behind: big crossing strokes of a hog brush, softened, a dull glow behind the bowl, near black at the corners.

steps.name: Table
steps.note: Dark walnut: the top in long strokes along the grain, the bevel catching the window, the front in shadow.

steps.name: Cloth: dead colour
steps.note: The linen laid in thin: its shadows and middle tones, no lights yet.

steps.name: Cloth: modelling
steps.note: Every fold turned with the brush along it, then softened with a clean brush while it is wet.

steps.name: Cloth: lights
steps.note: The crests of the folds caught along their length in stiff paint, the brightest thick; the hollows drawn dark.

steps.name: Bowl: inside
steps.note: The inner wall seen over the rim: its far side lit, the near side under the shadow of the rim.

steps.name: Lemon in the bowl
steps.note: A dark ochre ground, the yellow turned round the form and softened, the lights laid thick into it, the window on the shoulder.

steps.name: Bowl: body
steps.note: The white body turned with the brush round its form, light on the left and grey toward the right, a warm bounce near the foot.

steps.name: Bowl: decoration
steps.note: Kraak panels in cobalt: a pale wash in each broad panel, drawn over in deep blue with a flower and leaves; beads in the narrow ones; bands at the rim and the foot.

steps.name: Bowl: glaze and lights
steps.note: The glassy lights: the window on the shoulder, the lit rim, the chips of glaze at the rim; the foot sitting in its shadow.

steps.name: Lemon on the cloth
steps.note: A dark ochre ground, the yellow turned round the form and softened, the lights laid thick into it, the window on the shoulder.

steps.name: Knife
steps.note: A pewter blade lying on the table with its dark handle over the edge: the cold light along its back, the lemon reflected near its point.

steps.name: Peel
steps.note: The ribbon of peel: yellow outside, white pith inside; it lies across the table, curls over the edge and hangs free.

steps.name: Cut lemon: its shadow
steps.note: The shadow the half lemon throws to the right along the table, darkest where it touches.

steps.name: Cut lemon: rind
steps.note: A dark ochre ground, the yellow turned round the form and softened, the lights laid thick into it, the window on the shoulder.

steps.name: Cut lemon: the cut face
steps.note: Pith, the ring of rind, segments of wet pulp drawn out from the core, pale membranes, a pip, beads of juice.

steps.name: Shadows and accents
steps.note: Contact shadows deepened with a glaze; two pips on the table; the darkest darks last.

steps.name: Varnish
steps.note: A thin coat of warm varnish over everything: it binds the colours and gives the darks back their depth.
